points.title: Quotation
points.must: Exact words of a source in quotation marks, followed by a citation.

points.title: Paraphrase and summary
points.must: Paraphrase = one idea fully in own words and structure; summary = main points, much shorter; both need a citation.

points.title: Common knowledge
points.must: Widely known facts need no citation; statistics, opinions and findings do.

points.title: Quote / paraphrase / summary example
points.must: One source used in the three ways, each with a citation.

points.title: Harvard citation
points.must: In-text (author, year); reference list entry for a book and a web page; alphabetical order.

points.title: How to paraphrase
points.must: Understand, close the source, write from memory, compare with the original, add the citation.

points.title: Copyright
points.must: The exclusive legal right of the author of an original work to copy, distribute, adapt and publish it and to allow or forbid others.

points.title: Licence and public domain
points.must: Licence = permission under conditions, not ownership; public domain = no longer protected, free to use.

points.title: Rules of copyright protection
points.must: At least five: automatic, original work, economic and moral rights, life + 70 years, permission / licence needed, ideas not protected, limited free use with source, software protected, consequences.

points.title: The life of a copyright
points.must: Created → protected during life → 70 years after death → public domain.

points.title: Creative Commons
points.must: BY, NC, ND, SA (and CC0) with meanings.

points.title: Copyright law in Kazakhstan
points.must: Law "On Copyright and Related Rights" and the Civil Code; programs and databases are protected.

points.title: Using others' work in a project
points.must: Rules for quotations, photos, music, code, a classmate's work; the school website worked example.

points.title: Plagiarism vs copyright infringement
points.must: Plagiarism = not acknowledging the source (ethical / academic); infringement = using without permission (legal); both can happen together.
